title: Sample: a village bakery
text: Maria opened her bakery ten years ago. [[1]] Her first customers were neighbours. [[2]] Soon the queue reached the street. [[3]] She hired two helpers. [[4]] The work began at four every morning. [[5]] Today she teaches baking at the local school. [[6]]

paragraphs.text: This success surprised her, because she had never run a business.
At first she baked alone in a tiny kitchen.
Not everyone was happy about the noise, however.
Those early mornings taught her to plan carefully.
Her students often ask her for the secret of her bread.
Meanwhile, the weather in the region was changing.
They told friends, and word of the bread spread fast.

explanation.en: "At first" starts the story and leads to "Her first customers".
explanation.cs: "At first" otevírá příběh a navazuje na "first customers".

explanation.en: "This success" refers to the long queue.
"however" signals a contrasting problem after growth.
